title: Triples-to-Text Generation with Reinforcement Learning Based Graph-augmented Structural Neural Networks
reasoning: The paper uses the term 'faithfulness' to refer to the factual accuracy and correctness of the generated text with respect to the input RDF triples, not to religious faith, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethics in a societal or philosophical sense. It proposes an IE-based RL reward to improve text faithfulness by ensuring the generated text contains correct triples from the input data. This is a technical evaluation metric within natural language generation, focusing on factual consistency rather than ethical considerations of the content itself.
